item.title: How to Hide Taskbar in Windows 10: A Simple Step-by-Step Guide
item.description:
Hiding the taskbar on Windows 10 is easiest by turning on the built-in auto-hide feature. This lets the taskbar disappear when you're not using it, giving you more screen space without losing quick access to your apps.
Why Auto-Hide Works Better Than Moving or Minimizing the Taskbar
